A '''predator lizard''' was a [[Diet/Legends|carnivorous]] frill-neck predator native to the [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forests]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirtania]]. They were between one-point-nine to two and half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and lived in the branches of the [[Tree/Legends|trees]] in the rain forest. The [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]] had four legs which terminated in sharp claws.
